items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tiger Woods! Here’s a guy growing up with all these great golfers...

ctx.x: Tiger Woods! Here’s a guy growing up with all these great golfers, and these whores following these guys on these tours. He ain’t the first guy that had a babe, by far. Those same whores move on to another guy. When there’s money being made by these athletes, they go to these clubs and all these guys…they migrate to these clubs where these whores hang out. They know the money is there. They know that’s a $1,000 hit, as opposed to the streetwalker. Do you think Mike Tyson would have a better position if Don King…
